’Twas the month before Christmas and weeks after ween — where the hallows craft gallows and hang old routines.
lines.zh: 那是圣诞节前的一月、万圣节后的数周——此地圣徒搭起绞架，把旧日的惯例吊死。

lines.en: How curious, furious at all that I see. To think that one night could rewrite this for me.
lines.zh: 我眼中所见的一切，何等离奇、何等恼人。想想吧，仅仅一夜就能为我重写这一切。

lines.en: Will the future be sutured to match how he used her? Where it seems that the seams come unraveled (or looser).
lines.zh: 未来会被缝合起来，好契合他曾经如何对待她吗？而那些缝合的线似乎正在松脱（或者越来越松）。

lines.en: ’Twas whatever, whenever. I don’t care. Why bother? This has nothing to do with a father or daughter.
lines.zh: 管它是什么，管它在何时。我不在乎。何必费心？这跟一个父亲或一个女儿毫无关系。

lines.en: But it DOES have something to do with some other stuff that needs to blah blah blah sex fuck cum shit fuck dick fuck. Makoto.
lines.zh: 但它确实跟另一些事情有关，那些需要 blah blah blah 性操精液屎操鸡巴操的事情。Makoto。

lines.en: : What are you doing here? I thought you’d be with your friends.
lines.zh: : 你在这儿干什么？我还以为你会跟朋友们在一起。

lines.en: : I needed a break for a minute. They’re making me feel crazy.
lines.zh: : 我需要休息一会儿。她们让我觉得自己疯了。

lines.en: : I see. Well, have you stopped to consider for a second that you may actually just be crazy?
lines.zh: : 这样啊。那么，你有没有停下来想过一秒，也许你真的就是疯了？

lines.en: : Yeah, that’s kind of what this break is. How are things in here? Are you having fun?
lines.zh: : 是啊，这次休息差不多就是为了这个。这里面怎么样？你玩得开心吗？

lines.en: : Uhh...I suppose.
lines.zh: : 呃……大概吧。

lines.en: scene christmalloweenroom3
: Am I bothering you? Should I leave? I don’t normally come to parties my daughter is at. How do I mom in this scenario?
lines.zh: : 我打扰到你了吗？我要不要走？我平时不会来我女儿参加的派对。这种情况下我该怎么当妈？

lines.en: : You’re not {i}bothering{/i} me, per se. I’m clearly not doing anything since Miku is relaxing in the quiet room.
lines.zh: : 严格来说你并没有{i}打扰{/i}我。反正我显然什么都没在做，因为 Miku 正在安静室里放松。

lines.en: : I just don’t really get {i}why{/i} you’re here. Or why being crazy is suddenly an issue to you at all when you spend at least ten hours a day reorganizing rubber penises.
lines.zh: : 我只是不太明白你{i}为什么{/i}在这儿。也不明白，一个每天至少花十个小时整理橡胶鸡巴的人，怎么会突然把「疯了」当成一个问题。

lines.en: scene christmalloweenroom4
: Heh. You said {i}penis.{/i}
lines.zh: : 嘿。你说了{i}鸡巴{/i}。

lines.en: scene christmalloweenroom5
: Okay, listen. Me and the girls had a-
lines.zh: : 好吧，听着。我和姑娘们有个——

lines.en: : The girls and I.
lines.zh: : 是姑娘们和我。

lines.en: : The girls and I had a talk about Christmalloween costumes and how I think they’re just...you know...
lines.zh: : 姑娘们和我聊了聊 Christmalloween 的服装，还有我觉得它们只是……你知道的……

lines.en: : Potentially being abused by some girls your age who might not understand the potential ramifications or consequences of expressing sexual freedom before getting out of high school.
lines.zh: : 可能会被你这个年纪的一些女孩滥用，她们也许并不理解在高中毕业之前表达性自由可能带来的后果或影响。

lines.en: : How long did it take you to memorize the wording of that?
lines.zh: : 你背这套说辞背了多久？

lines.en: : Like five minutes. I don’t think I’ve ever used “ramification” in a sentence before.
lines.zh: : 大概五分钟。我觉得我这辈子还没在句子里用过「后果」这个词。

lines.en: scene christmalloweenroom6
: Heh. {i}Ram-{/i}ification. Like sex.
lines.zh: : 嘿。{i}干-{/i}果。就像性一样。

lines.en: : The dichotomy of your tone right now is taking me for quite the ride.
lines.zh: : 你现在语气的这种两面性，可真是让我坐了一趟过山车。

lines.en: scene christmalloweenroom7
: Okay, but-
lines.zh: : 好吧，不过——

lines.en: : And before you reach for some other euphemism about {i}being taken for a ride{/i} or whatever you’re in the process of saying, know that you will be falling directly into my trap.
lines.zh: : 而在你去找别的什么关于{i}被带出去兜风{/i}的委婉说法、或者你正准备说的那些话之前，先知道一点：你会直接掉进我的陷阱里。

lines.en: : Makoto, you know what I’m saying, right? That some of the costumes you girls normally wear for these parties, like...
lines.zh: : Makoto，你懂我的意思吧？你们这些姑娘平时穿去这些派对的那些服装，比如说……

lines.en: : Well, they’re wearing them specifically so Sensei will look at them, right?
lines.zh: : 嗯，她们穿那些，就是专门为了让 Sensei 看她们，对吧？

lines.en: : Some of them, sure. Is that really something you should be saying when you’re dressed like {i}that,{/i} though?
lines.zh: : 有些人确实是。不过你自己穿成{i}那样{/i}，说这话真的合适吗？

lines.en: : I’m an adult. It’s {i}fine{/i} if people want to ramify me. You girls are different, though. You girls are only-
lines.zh: : 我是成年人。别人想「干」我，那{i}没关系{/i}。可你们这些女孩不一样。你们只是——

lines.en: : Doing what we want to do and not succumbing to the archaic ideology that we should be dressing modestly in order to avoid the male gaze. What happened to you?
lines.zh: : 在做我们想做的事，没有向那种过时的观念屈服——说什么为了避开男性凝视就该穿得保守。你是怎么了？

lines.en: scene christmalloweenroom8
: What do you {i}mean{/i} what happened to me? Just look around at-
lines.zh: : 你{i}什么意思{/i}，我怎么了？你倒是看看周围——

lines.en: scene christmalloweenroom9
: Oh. I guess it’s not actually that bad this year.
lines.zh: : 哦。我想今年其实没那么糟。

lines.en: : What I {i}meant{/i} is that this isn’t something I’d expect you to complain about. And I’m curious as to why you are now going out of your way to approach me about it for support.
lines.zh: : 我{i}想说{/i}的是，这不是我预期你会抱怨的事。而且我很好奇，你为什么现在特意来找我说这个、想求得支持。

lines.en: scene christmalloweenroom10
: Can a mother not look out for other girls now? I just don’t want any of you getting sucked into something you don’t fully understand yet.
lines.zh: : 一个母亲现在都不能替别的女孩操心了吗？我只是不想你们任何人被卷进自己还没完全明白的事情里。

lines.en: : Like, freedom or not, willingly taking your clothes off and then parading your body in front of an older guy is {i}going{/i} to send some signals.
lines.zh: : 比如说，不管自不自由，主动脱掉衣服、再在一个年纪更大的男人面前展示身体，{i}一定{/i}会传递出某些信号。

lines.en: : I’m sorry, do I look {i}unclothed{/i} right now? Why are you talking to {i}me{/i} about this?
lines.zh: : 抱歉，我现在看起来有{i}没穿衣服{/i}吗？你为什么跟{i}我{/i}说这些？

lines.en: : I’m practically the queen of modesty among my peers. Which is quite odd considering I work in a sex shop.
lines.zh: : 在同龄人里，我简直就是端庄女王。想想我在情趣用品店上班，这还挺奇怪的。

lines.en: : I’m just worried. That’s all. You’re still a teenager and-
lines.zh: : 我只是担心。就这样。你还是个十几岁的孩子，而且——

lines.en: : And, with all due respect, I’m smarter {i}and{/i} more mature than you. So maybe {i}I{/i} should be the one lecturing {i}you{/i} about sexual safety?
lines.zh: : 而恕我直言，我比你更聪明，{i}也{/i}比你更成熟。所以也许该由{i}我{/i}来给{i}你{/i}上性安全课？

lines.en: scene christmalloweenroom11
: What? {i}Makoto?{/i} I’m just-
lines.zh: : 什么？{i}Makoto？{/i}我只是——

lines.en: : I apologize if that sounded harsh or rude. I just think you’re putting a little too much stake on a number and not enough on a person’s character. That’s all.
lines.zh: : 如果那听起来刺耳或粗鲁，我道歉。我只是觉得你在一个数字上押了太多注，而对一个人的品格押得不够。就这样。

lines.en: scene christmalloweenroom12
: Plenty of girls start having sex at my age. It’s completely normal. You should understand firsthand the battlefield that is puberty as you went through it yourself.
lines.zh: : 很多女孩在我这个年纪就开始有性生活了。这完全正常。你自己也经历过青春期，应该切身理解那片战场才对。

lines.en: : I did. But the {i}context{/i} matters here.
lines.zh: : 我是经历过。可这里的{i}语境{/i}很重要。

lines.en: : Most of you girls are {i}specifically{/i} trying to capture Sensei’s attention. And that’s bad for both you {i}and{/i} him. I could care less if it was happening with-
lines.zh: : 你们大多数女孩是{i}专门{/i}想吸引 Sensei 的注意。那对你{i}和{/i}对他都不好。这种事如果是跟别人发生的，我可以更不在乎——

lines.en: : {i}Couldn’t{/i} care less.
lines.zh: : 是{i}根本{/i}不在乎。

lines.en: scene christmalloweenroom13
: What?...
: You {i}couldn’t{/i} care less. Saying you {i}could{/i} care less implies that you don’t feel all that strongly one way or the other.
lines.zh: : 是{i}根本{/i}不在乎。说「我可以更不在乎」，意味着你对此其实并没有那么强烈的感觉。

lines.en: : And again, with all due respect, if you can’t understand even that much, you probably shouldn’t be lecturing people about the nuances of sex. Just saying.
lines.zh: : 再说一次，恕我直言，如果连这点你都搞不明白，你大概也不该来对别人讲性的微妙之处。随口一说。

lines.en: scene christmalloweenroom14
: Anything else?
lines.zh: : 还有别的吗？

lines.en: : Does talking down to people who aren’t as smart as you make you feel superior, Makoto?
lines.zh: : 用居高临下的口气跟没你聪明的人说话，会让你觉得自己高人一等吗，Makoto？

lines.en: : Are you not doing the same thing right now? Because it sure sounds like you’re telling me that {i}you{/i} know what’s better for me than I do.
lines.zh: : 你现在不也在做同样的事吗？因为听起来你就是在告诉我，{i}你{/i}比我自己更清楚什么对我好。

lines.en: : {size=-3}And to that I say — was it {i}also{/i} necessary to have so much audible group sex down the hall from me when I was even {i}younger?{/i} Because I’d love to hear how that was a positive influence on my sexual growth.{/size}
lines.zh: : {size=-3}对此我只想说——在我{i}更小{/i}的时候，{i}也{/i}有必要在走廊那头搞出那么大声的群交吗？我还真想听听那对我的性成长有什么正面影响。{/size}

lines.en: : So you think I’m crazy too then?...
lines.zh: : 那你也觉得我疯了？……

lines.en: : I don’t think anyone thinks you’re crazy. I think that’s just how you interpreted a disagreement on what, to you, seems like black and white ethics.
lines.zh: : 我不觉得有人认为你疯了。我觉得那只是你解读一场分歧的方式——那场分歧在你看来是非黑即白的道德问题。

lines.en: : But there’s far more {i}nuance{/i} to this than you understand, Mom.
lines.zh: : 可这里的{i}微妙之处{/i}远比你理解的多，妈妈。

lines.en: : And I’m going to keep being myself at the risk of becoming like you if I don’t.
lines.zh: : 而我会继续做我自己，哪怕不这么做就有变成你这样的风险。

lines.en: scene black
: Okay...
lines.zh: : 好吧……

lines.en: : Maybe I {i}don’t{/i} know what I’m talking about then...
lines.zh: : 也许我{i}确实{/i}不知道自己在说什么……

lines.en: scene christmalloweenroom15
: Yumi! Hi. Would it be weird if I gave you a present?
lines.zh: : Yumi！嗨。我送你个礼物会不会很奇怪？

lines.en: : Yes.
: Why?
lines.zh: : 为什么？

lines.en: : Uhh...because we’ve talked like one time? And because the last time you handed me something, I opened it and found out my mom had cancer.
lines.zh: : 呃……因为我们大概就说过一次话？还有，上次你递给我什么东西，我打开一看，发现我妈得了癌症。

lines.en: scene christmalloweenroom16
: It ain’t a death certificate in there this time, is it? Can it wait until the party’s over?
lines.zh: : 这回里面不是死亡证明吧，是吗？能不能等派对结束再说？

lines.en: : It’s just a birthday present. I wouldn’t attach a candy cane to a death certificate. That’s so totally tone-deaf.
lines.zh: : 只是个生日礼物罢了。我才不会把拐杖糖绑在死亡证明上呢。那也太不解风情了。

lines.en: : Ain’t it the middle of November? My birthday’s the 31st of last month on a holiday you guys don’t believe in anymore.
lines.zh: : 现在不是十一月中旬吗？我的生日是上个月 31 号，那天是你们现在已经不信的一个节日。

lines.en: scene christmalloweenroom17
: Really? Then your records at school are wrong because I might have looked into them to try and figure out the date.
lines.zh: : 真的吗？那你在学校的档案就错了，因为我可能查过，想弄清楚日期。

lines.en: : That’s an invasion of privacy if I’ve ever fuckin’ heard one.
lines.zh: : 这他妈绝对算侵犯隐私了。

lines.en: : Yes. But I also know your three sizes now, so it’s possible I used that information to buy you a fancy bra and shoved it inside this package. Don’t you want to open it and find out?
lines.zh: : 是的。不过我现在也知道你的三围了，所以我很可能利用这些信息给你买了一件漂亮胸罩，塞进了这个包裹里。你就不想打开看看吗？

lines.en: scene christmalloweenroom18
: Not really. But I’m startin’ to think that openin’ it might be the only way to get you to leave me alone, so...
lines.zh: : 不太想。不过我开始觉得，打开它也许是唯一能让你别缠着我的办法，所以……

lines.en: : Great. Well, fair warning, it’s not a bra. I’m sorry if I got your hopes up.
lines.zh: : 太好了。嗯，先提醒一下，那不是胸罩。让你空欢喜一场，我很抱歉。

lines.en: : Not a thing I’d be excited to receive anyway...
lines.zh: : 反正也不是什么我会兴奋收到的东西……

lines.en: scene christmalloweenroom19
: But, uhh...thanks, I-
lines.zh: : 不过，呃……谢了，我——

lines.en: : Great! Cool! So anyway, now that you’ve accepted my gift, how’s your mom?
lines.zh: : 太好了！不错！那么，既然你收下了我的礼物，你妈妈怎么样了？

lines.en: scene christmalloweenroom20
: You ain’t even gonna let me open it before flashin’ me your ulterior motive?
lines.zh: : 你连让我拆开都不肯，就先把你的真实目的亮出来了？

lines.en: : I’ve accidentally flashed so many people today that I’m just going to write a blanket apology letter and read it in school next week. Also, it’s just a shirt in there. So, yeah. Yuki?
lines.zh: : 我今天不小心露给那么多人看了，干脆写封通用的道歉信，下周在学校念一遍算了。另外，里面只是件衬衫。所以，嗯。Yuki？

lines.en: : You know, you could’ve just asked me about her {i}without{/i} givin’ me shit. I don’t need a bribe.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗，你完全可以{i}不{/i}塞东西给我，直接问我就行。我不需要贿赂。

lines.en: : It helps though, yeah?
lines.zh: : 不过有用，对吧？

lines.en: scene christmalloweenroom21
: Yeah, kinda. What do you want to know?
lines.zh: : 嗯，有点用。你想知道什么？

lines.en: : Well, to start, is she feeling any better? Because she {i}looks{/i} better. She came by to pick up some stuff from her apartment a few weeks ago and I almost didn’t recognize her at first.
lines.zh: : 嗯，首先，她感觉好点了吗？因为她{i}看起来{/i}好多了。几周前她来公寓拿东西，我一开始差点没认出她。

lines.en: : Also, totally random question, but could you maybe estimate the percentage of gay that she is? Rounding up, please.
lines.zh: : 还有，完全随口一问——你能不能估算一下她有多弯？请往上取整。

lines.en: scene christmalloweenroom22
: She has fuckin’ cancer now and you’re tryin’ to flirt with her? Through her daughter?
lines.zh: : 她现在他妈得了癌症，你还想勾搭她？还是通过她女儿？

lines.en: : You probably see this as crazy, but {i}I{/i} see my persistence as a plus. I’m goal-oriented, loyal, and I can do things with my tongue that normal humans could never even fathom.
lines.zh: : 你大概觉得这很疯狂，但{i}我{/i}觉得我的执着是个加分项。我目标明确、忠诚，而且我的舌头能做出普通人类根本想象不到的事。

lines.en: : You don’t have to tell her that part, though. I’d prefer to show her on my own once she stops ignoring me and lets me convert her.
lines.zh: : 不过那部分你不用告诉她。我更想等她不再无视我、肯让我「改造」她的时候，亲自展示给她看。

lines.en: scene christmalloweenroom23
: Yeah, good luck with that. She’s got some other lady draggin’ her around like a pet now. Figure if anyone’s gonna {i}convert{/i} my mom, it’ll be her.
lines.zh: : 行吧，祝你好运。现在有个女人把她当宠物似的牵着到处走。我觉得要是有人能{i}改造{/i}我妈，那就是她了。

lines.en: : Sorry. Could you repeat that? Just without all that stuff about some other woman being in the picture now so I can wipe it from my memory and pretend it never happened?
lines.zh: : 抱歉。你能再说一遍吗？就去掉那部分——什么现在有个别的女人掺和进来——好让我把它从记忆里抹掉，假装它从没发生过？

lines.en: scene christmalloweenroom24
: The fuck you even interested in that piece of shit for? Yuki ain’t good for nothin’. All she does is fuckin’ lie and talk shit.
lines.zh: : 你他妈到底看上那个废物什么了？Yuki 一点用都没有。她整天就他妈撒谎、说人坏话。

lines.en: : Like, if you need a bodyguard, there are probably better options now and-
lines.zh: : 比如说，你要是需要保镖，现在肯定有更好的选择，而且——

lines.en: : Yumi, I’ll give it to you straight. I am chronically alone. I have a pillow in my bedroom I use specifically for crying into.
lines.zh: : Yumi，我就直说了。我长期孤独。我卧室里有个枕头，专门用来埋着头哭的。

lines.en: : Your mom is hot. We are close in age. She is my type. And also I can fix her.
lines.zh: : 你妈很辣。我们年纪相近。她是我喜欢的类型。而且我还能修好她。

lines.en: : Now, tell me who I am competing against so I can look them up online and then probably cry when I realize they’re younger and prettier than me.
lines.zh: : 现在，告诉我我的竞争对手是谁，好让我上网查查，然后等发现她们比我年轻、比我漂亮时大概会哭一场。

lines.en: : Just fuckin’ call her. You have her number, don’t you?
lines.zh: : 你就他妈直接打给她啊。你有她电话吧？

lines.en: scene christmalloweenroom25
: Yes! But like I said, she keeps ignoring me! It’s almost like she doesn’t want to talk or something! I don’t get it! There’s no way she’s a 0%%’er! All girls are at least a little gay!
lines.zh: : 有啊！可就像我说的，她一直无视我！简直就像她不想说话似的！我不懂！她不可能是 0%% 弯的！所有女孩至少都有一点弯！

lines.en: : I ain’t. Do I just not exist or somethin’?
lines.zh: : 我就不弯。难道我不存在吗还是怎么的？

lines.en: scene black
: Oh God! Is it genetic?! Is {i}that{/i} curable too?! See if the hospital will-
lines.zh: : 哦天哪！这是遗传吗？！{i}那{/i}也能治吗？！去问问医院能不能——

lines.en: : Anyway! Thanks for the shirt. I am now walking away forever. Goodbye and do not talk to me.
lines.zh: : 总之！谢谢你的衬衫。我现在要永远走开了。再见，别跟我说话。

lines.en: : Ahh! It’s like {i}you{/i} don’t want to talk either now! What is going on?!
lines.zh: : 啊！怎么连{i}你{/i}现在也不想说话了！到底怎么回事？！

lines.en: scene christmalloweenroom26
: So, have you {i}really{/i} just been wandering around looking for my dad all night?
lines.zh: : 那么，你{i}真的{/i}一整晚都在到处找我的爸爸吗？

lines.en: : Are you asking me as a friend, co-worker, rival, daughter, or incest demon?
lines.zh: : 你是以朋友、同事、情敌、女儿，还是乱伦恶魔的身份在问我？
